ns2:section.sectionText: For Unit One and other LLC students only. Placement in this course requires a recent U of I Math Placement Exam score of at least 70%. Failure to achieve the minimum score will result in removal from the course. For details see http://www.math.uiuc.edu/ALEKS/.
